tasks.title: Greeting
tasks.statement: Write a function greet(name) that returns a string like «Привет, Аня!», that is, «Привет, » + the name + an exclamation mark. Use an f-string.
tasks.hint: f"Привет, {name}!" — the curly braces substitute the value.

tasks.title: Area of a rectangle
tasks.statement: Write a function area(a, b) that returns the area of a rectangle with sides a and b.
tasks.hint: The area is the product of the sides: return a * b.

tasks.title: Fahrenheit to Celsius
tasks.statement: Write a function to_celsius(f) that converts a temperature from Fahrenheit to Celsius using the formula (f - 32) * 5 / 9 and returns the result.
tasks.hint: The formula is already in the statement: return (f - 32) * 5 / 9. In Python, parentheses set the order.
